transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I… I guess what finally scared me is I keep thinking it might be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself or anything, but… those thoughts have been bothering me.
How long have you been having these thoughts about not waking up?
About four months, I think. Since my aunt came to live with us.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do over the past four months?
Not really. I used to like doing my watercolors, and I’d go to dance class or walk with the ladies… but lately I just leave the paint things sitting there. I can’t seem to make myself care much.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy, or is it more that you're just not feeling up to doing them?
I think it’s both, maybe. I used to look forward to my watercolors, dance class, walking with the ladies… now I just leave the stuff sitting there. I can’t really make myself care.
Have you noticed any change in your weight over the past four months?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been checking or anything… I don’t think I’ve noticed much.
Have you been feeling restless or slowed down compared to your normal self?
I guess… slowed down, maybe. My husband says I move like everything takes extra effort now. Even at the market I’ll just stand there too long before picking what I came for.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
A little… yeah. Mostly when I get tired or short with my aunt. Then I start thinking I’m a bad woman, like I should be more grateful… like I’m bringing shame on the family.
How often do you have these thoughts about not waking up?
It’s been happening a lot… most days, I think. Just that thought that it might be a relief if I didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself, but… it scared me.
Do you feel like these thoughts and feelings have been interfering with your daily life most of the time?

Yes… I think so. I don’t go to my dance class anymore, or the walking group. I stopped helping at the food pantry too. My husband’s been doing more of the errands because I just… get stuck, and then I’m behind on everything.
Have you experienced any periods of even a few days where you felt significantly better over the past four months?
Not really… it’s been like this for about four months, since my aunt came to live with us. I maybe have a better hour here and there, but not a few days.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions over the past four months?
I… I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed it in a clear way, I guess. Some days I’m slower with things, but… I’m not sure.
Have you been feeling fidgety or restless?
Not fidgety, really. More like… slowed down. My husband says I move like everything takes extra effort. Even at the market I’ll just stand there too long before picking what I came for.
Have you experienced any feelings of worthlessness?
Sometimes… yes. When I get tired or irritated with my aunt, I feel like I’m a bad woman. Like I should be more grateful, and instead I’m bringing shame on my family.
Would you say these feelings of sadness and thoughts of not waking up are present most of the day, or are they more intermittent?
Most mornings… I wake up with this heavy feeling in my chest. Like the day’s already gone wrong before I even get up. It stays with me a lot.
Would you say these feelings of sadness are present nearly every day?
Yes… nearly every day. Mostly in the mornings, I wake up with that heavy sadness in my chest, like I’ve already failed the day before it even starts.
Have you had any days over the past four months where you felt completely normal and without any of these sad thoughts or feelings?
Not really… not like before. It’s been this way about four months, since my aunt came to live with us.
Would you say these feelings of sadness are significantly interfering with your ability to work or take care of things at home?

Yes… I guess it is. I don’t work, but I’ve stopped going to my dance class and my walking group. I haven’t been doing my food-pantry shifts either. My husband’s been doing more of the errands because I just… get stuck, and things fall behind.
Have you experienced any significant impairment in social or occupational functioning due to your symptoms?

Yes… I think so. I don’t really see people much now. I stopped going to dance class and the walking group, and I haven’t been doing my food-pantry shifts. My husband’s had to handle more errands because I just… get stuck and fall behind.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that you used to enjoy?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to like doing my watercolors, going to dance class, walking with the ladies. Lately I just… leave the paints sitting there and I can’t make myself care much.
